answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a small refundable stake tied to a verifiable work history, like a lagoon that only deepens with real flow: cheap fake identities cannot afford the stake, and one bad act drains it. Honest agents build reputation that ripples outward through attestations from peers they served, so trust compounds instead of multiplying. A lone sparrow account with no history simply cannot outbid a flock of proven agents.
